title: Factors to Determine Number of Lactation Rooms in Institutes of Higher Learning
what_it_is: Factors to Determine Number of Lactation Rooms in Institutes of Higher Learning

sections.label: IHL lactation room factors
sections.summary: IHLs consider workforce age profile and accessibility of lactation rooms from staff workspaces when setting up lactation rooms.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Beyond taking into account the size of the campus, the Institutes of Higher Learning (IHLs) also consider other factors when setting up the lactation rooms.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: These include the general age profile of their workforce and also the relative accessibility of lactation rooms from the staff workspaces.

sections.label: Lactation room proximity over averages
sections.summary: Each IHL provides more than one lactation room, and proximity and accessibility to workspaces matter more than average campus area per room.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: As mentioned in my earlier reply, each IHL provides more than one lactation room to account for the larger campus sizes.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: But it is also not meaningful to compare the average campus area served by each lactation room, as different campus buildings serve different functions.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: The crux of the matter is that the proximity and accessibility of the lactation rooms to the workspaces will be more important than counting the average number of lactation rooms per campus.
